title: Insulin peak time. "Activity" or "concentration"?
symptom: The user is confused about the role of the insulin model in AndroidAPS, specifically whether the peak time setting corresponds to peak insulin concentration or peak activity (glucose-decreasing effect). They question the benefit of assuming peak time equals peak concentration time for IOB computation.
cause: The thread discusses the distinction between insulin concentration and activity. The maintainer (scottleibrand) states that the blue curve is activity (BG-decreasing effect) and that empirically, with autotune, the peak time is close to default values in oref0, closer to 1 hour than 2.
fix: No specific fix is provided; the discussion clarifies that the peak time in the model represents activity, not concentration, and that autotune can estimate insulinPeakTime with enough data.
evidence_quote: The blue curve is activity: BG-decreasing effect. We have empirically tested that using autotune (with enough data, it can estimate insulinPeakTime) and find it to be close to the default values in oref0.
